## Staging evidence

`sha-c8e3dee` passed staging 2026-10-15T19:08:27Z.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| pods running and ready | 8 running |
| no crash loop | 0 restarts |
| every service runs sha-c8e3dee | ok |
| running digest equals the ECR digest | all four match |
| gateway reaches the database, migrated | migrated to c3e8a1d7f402 |
| GET /v1/incidents?limit=1 | HTTP 200 |
| GET /v1/signals?limit=1 | HTTP 200 |

Not covered by that pass:

- Ollama and the model: no environment deploys one yet, so /healthz's ollama check is expected to fail and is not gated on
- agent diagnosis and proposals: they need the model
- the backup image: published, not deployed to staging
- Slack approval: staging has no Slack app of its own

What the gate checked when the promotion was started:

```
release sha-0904d5c -> sha-c8e3dee: stories KAV-83, KAV-84, KAV-85, KAV-87, KAV-88

  PASS  ECR digests equal the digests that passed: all four match
  PASS  every uat story in the release is signed off: 5 stories, 0 with uat, all accepted

sha-c8e3dee may be promoted to prod.
```

## Rollback plan

Prod runs `sha-0904d5c` today, so that is the version to go back to.

```
gh workflow run rollback.yml --ref main -f tag=sha-0904d5c -f reason="<why>"
```

Going back crosses no database migration.

Last measured: about 80 seconds from merging the rollback pull request to every service healthy (staging, 2026-10-09, ADR-0034). Prod's own time has not been measured. Runbook: `docs/runbooks/rollback-prod.md`.
